blocks.md: On this book's own release and approval records (a later section and a later section), the warehouse mobile manipulator is refused. Even the stipulated evidence branch earns it only conditional service, held in place by premises that no sensor on the machine reports, such as the friction of the aisle floor. Improving its learned models alone would not change that verdict while the supporting physical and timing premises remain unqualified.

questions.q: The section **From a Better Prediction to Useful Service** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Open register entries fall into classes by the evidence they lack (an unmeasured observable, an evaluation deficit, a theoretical deficit) or by a scope mismatch that no evidence inside the present architecture repairs, and the class, not the urgency, selects the next experiment, with each restriction priced against the campaign that would retire it.

The method transfers to an unfamiliar machine as four ordered questions (what the task cannot undo and which measured bound excludes it, whether closed-loop evidence covers the enforced envelope, which independent path admits each proposal, and what evidence bounds the authority granted), not as the warehouse machine's numbers.

A shield's per-command guarantee becomes a hazard-rate claim only conditionally, lambda_sys <= lambda_h(1 - c) + lambda_cc, and observed fleet rates already include the shield, so multiplying them by an interception factor double-counts.

A premise no onboard sensor reports is not the envelope's monitored unknown, so it is bound to a standing restriction, an accountable owner, and a predeclared closure test, chosen among responses (probe, restrict, add sensing, accept by judgment) by the claim each can support.
